entities.define_prompt: The X-axis representing opposing conceptual vectors related to time.
entities.name: 时间维度

entities.define_prompt: The Y-axis representing another set of conceptual vectors related to tasks.
entities.name: 任务维度

entities.define_prompt: Positive direction on X-axis representing urgency. From ThinkPoint, extract tasks that are urgent.
entities.name: 紧急

entities.define_prompt: Negative direction on X-axis representing non-urgency. From ThinkPoint, extract tasks that are not urgent.
entities.name: 不紧急

entities.define_prompt: Positive direction on Y-axis representing importance. From ThinkPoint, extract tasks that are important.
entities.name: 重要

entities.define_prompt: Negative direction on Y-axis representing non-importance. From ThinkPoint, extract tasks that are not important.
entities.name: 不重要

entities.define_prompt: First quadrant (Urgent, Important). Tasks that need immediate attention and contribute significantly to goals. Combine {{x_positive_urgent}} and {{y_positive_important}}.
entities.name: 紧急且重要

entities.define_prompt: Second quadrant (Not Urgent, Important). Tasks that contribute significantly to goals but don't require immediate attention. Combine {{x_negative_not_urgent}} and {{y_positive_important}}.
entities.name: 不紧急但重要

entities.define_prompt: Third quadrant (Not Urgent, Not Important). Tasks that don't contribute significantly to goals and don't require immediate attention. Combine {{x_negative_not_urgent}} and {{y_negative_not_important}}.
entities.name: 不紧急且不重要

entities.define_prompt: Fourth quadrant (Urgent, Not Important). Tasks that require immediate attention but don't contribute significantly to goals. Combine {{x_positive_urgent}} and {{y_negative_not_important}}.
entities.name: 紧急但不重要

entities.define_prompt: Horizontal axis symmetry—conversion between urgent and not urgent (e.g., Quadrant I <-> IV, II <-> III).
entities.name: 时间管理反转

entities.define_prompt: Vertical axis symmetry—conversion between important and not important (e.g., Quadrant I <-> II, IV <-> III).
entities.name: 任务管理反转

entities.define_prompt: Diagonal reverse—equivalent to applying both x_flip and y_flip in sequence. Maps Quadrant I (++) to Quadrant III (--), i.e., both axes flipped.
entities.name: 时间任务对角反转

entities.define_prompt: Diagonal swap—equivalent to applying both x_flip and y_flip in sequence. Maps Quadrant II (-+) to Quadrant IV (+-), i.e., both axes flipped but swaps the off-diagonal quadrants.
entities.name: 时间任务对角交换

model.name: Binary Orthogonal
model.description: A quadrant model using two conceptual axes (X and Y) to form four composite quadrant entities.
